scripts.check:generated: npm run gen:theme && npm run gen:builtin && npm run gen:registry && git diff --exit-code
scripts.build:theme: npm run gen:theme && npm run gen:builtin && npm run build -w @offthegully/veneerui
scripts.build:cli: npm run gen:registry && tsx scripts/sync-setup-assets.ts packages/cli && npm run build -w veneerui
scripts.build:create: npm run gen:registry && tsx scripts/sync-setup-assets.ts packages/create-veneerui && npm run build -w create-veneerui
scripts.build: npm run build:theme && npm run build -w playground && npm run build:cli && npm run build -w eslint-plugin-veneer && npm run build:create
scripts.dev: npm run build:theme && npm run dev -w playground
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run build:theme && npm run gen:registry && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run check:builtin && npm run build:theme && npm run gen:registry && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
